description:
Verify an already-made, buyer-authorized USDC payment and release its saved result.

            No transfer, approval or settlement is submitted by this tool. Use
            the exact quote claim message with the lower-case transaction hash
            and personal_sign by its payer wallet. Two RPC sources must agree
            on the native USDC event in a Base safe block. This can take minutes;
            retry the SAME quote/transaction, never send a second payment. One
            transaction pays one quote. QA is excluded and cannot accept money.
name: confirm_microtask
